title: Show that one positive entry cancels only one width-2 far direction
body:
## Summary
- On the length-9 width-2 cycle, deleting one vertex leaves vertices 2 and 7 at distance 4 with both Schur entries `-1/64`. The bandwidth is 4, and the inverse norms are `4772/2435`, inside `2` and `10`.
- One body entry `+1/64` zeros that direction and leaves the other at `-1/64`, so the bandwidth stays 4. Writing it in both directions drops the bandwidth to 3, below the touching diameter, with the distance-3 entries still `-1/64`.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
